# Invitation Draft: Independent Provider Compatibility Specialist

**Recipient:** [Nominate only after written authority verification]

Subject: PARMAR independent Provider Compatibility review request

Please review exact OIDC issuer/subject, claim semantics, normalization,
logout/revocation, subject-change, outage and isolated live-compatibility
requirements.

Required expertise: OIDC/OAuth provider interoperability and live protocol
verification. Independence: no provider-integrator or implementation conflict
that would prevent independent assessment.

Artifacts: `.github/approval/review-packages/provider-compatibility.md` and the
exact worktree SHA-256 values under `roles.Provider Compatibility` in
`.github/approval/specialist-handoff-artifacts.json`. These are candidate
digests only; verify and rebind them to the exact reviewed commit before
submitting an approval record.

Return `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `NEEDS_CHANGES` with exact provider,
configuration, tested claims, evidence, conditions and limitations.
